tldr: THE PIVOT: the Iran/Hormuz front DE-ESCALATED — Trump called off the threatened weekend strikes, talks began Monday, a Hormuz-reopening deal is 'imminent' — oil crashed ~5-7% and US equities ripped to records (S&P 7,600.50 +1.48%, Nasdaq +2.1%, Dow a record 53,178.41).

Biggest read for his book: the metals HELD their bid THROUGH the de-escalation (silver ~$58.5, gold >$4,050) even as the war premium unwound — the structural-deficit-bull tell, not just a fear trade. Favor gold-heavy GDX over pure silver leverage into Friday's jobs report.

The rate cap eased: 10Y back to ~4.7% (off its one-year high), core PCE cooled to 3.3%, labor softening — the Fed risk is more two-sided, a modest relief for levered silver and S-REITs; but 3.3% core is still hot, so the 7 Aug jobs print is the swing input.

HK-tech core supported: Hang Seng's best week since Sep-2025 on a 'moderately loose' Politburo pledge + Xiaomi +7.7% on new EVs — but a KOSPI rout on record foreign selling and SMIC -11% flag EM-Asia tech risk stays two-sided.

Smart money: no new 13Fs (Q2 due 14 Aug); congress is DISTRIBUTING mega-cap AI (NVDA/MSFT/GOOGL/AAPL), Himes trimmed energy just before the oil crash, and Burry's chip-short book is under pressure as semis rebound.

Regime nudged to risk-on 0.56 (from 0.53) — a genuine extension with the oil shock relieved and Fed risk balanced, but a record-high tape, sticky inflation, stretched positioning (BofA cash 3.6%) and an unsigned Iran deal cap how far it runs.
